itens.descricao: Why 3M Stock Jumped Today Yahoo Finance
trechos: Diversified industrial and materials-science company 3M (NYSE:MMM) is expanding its data center business, and that is helping its shares jump today.
The company announced an expansion of its commercial relationship with Amazon to deploy and scale 3M's optical connectivity and other data center products.
3M also boosted 2026 guidance for the third straight quarter.
That helped lead to a 5.1% jump in the stock as of 11:15 a.m.
In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia.
For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia.

In the deal with Amazon, 3M issued Amazon a warrant to buy up to 3.2 million 3M shares, tied to reaching $6 billion in cumulative sales of those data center products over seven years, plus other event-based milestones.
3M's adjusted earnings per share (EPS) jumped 12% year over year.

For a hypothetical example, owning 1,000 shares of Nike would provide quarterly income of $410, or an annualized payout of $1,640.

itens.titulo: BlackRock’s Secret Weapon Against Bitcoin Crashes Just Hit the SEC’s Desk
itens.descricao: BlackRock’s Secret Weapon Against Bitcoin Crashes Just Hit the SEC’s Desk Yahoo Finance
trechos: Key Takeaways - BlackRock filed with the SEC 19 to launch the iShares Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF (PBIT).

Unlike BlackRock's $65 billion iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT), the new product would use options contracts and fixed-income securities to provide Bitcoin-linked returns while seeking to limit downside exposure.

The filing arrives as Bitcoin trades around $81,500, approximately 26% below its level a year earlier, highlighting growing demand for investment products designed to manage cryptocurrency volatility.
The purchased calls would generally have strike prices approximately 10% below the reference asset's initial value.
